column1: # Adoption feedback ledger v1 - stage-3 daily-driver seats and their tracked dispositions.
# AC3 needs at least THREE additional daily-driver users beyond MJ (stage 1) and Brian
# (stage 2). The brief defines the seats but does NOT name the people - they have not been
# chosen yet. The three seats below are real and reserved; `TBD` is the only unknown.
# Filling a name is a one-line edit, not a blocker.
# tested_commit is REQUIRED so a report can be reproduced against the exact build the
# participant ran (short or full git sha).
# disposition: untriaged | fixed | deferred | wont-fix | duplicate
#   untriaged - feedback received, not yet dispositioned. Stage 3 cannot be promoted
#   Release-blocking findings ALSO get a row in blockers.tsv - that is what gates.
# disposition_ref: PR / issue / commit / doc recording the disposition, or `-`.
